description: Who the brand can iMessage, and tracked opt-in links. action list (default; status subscribed | unsubscribed, search, limit, offset): everyone on the contact list with an iMessage address, subscribed or opted out, when they last wrote, and the opt-in link that brought them. subscribe / unsubscribe { contact }: record their choice (an opted-out person is refused by send_imessage, broadcasts, groups and sequences until subscribed again; record subscribe only when they asked). create_link { body containing [opt-in-code], parameters {key: text} (e.g. campaign, leadId), optInCode? (3-8 letters/digits), from (the line people text) }: a link that opens Messages on the brand's line with the message ready; when it arrives, the person is opted in with those parameters, so the conversation is attributed to the campaign. A person writing first also gets past the provider's pacing for messages the brand starts. links: every link with opens and opt-ins. delete_link { id }. Free.
